requirement: A promise includes a complete valid request header section and invalid promises are rejected on the promised stream.

requirement: Send PUSH_PROMISE before response frames containing references to the promised resources.

requirement: A pushed response uses the promised server stream and the ordinary response frame sequence from HEADERS through END_STREAM.
notes: The frozen driver returns only the response to its explicit request and has no pushed-response observation.

requirement: After accepting a promise, avoid issuing duplicate requests for its resource until the promised stream closes.
notes: Needs a push-aware cache/application policy contract beyond a wire exchange operation.

requirement: An unwanted or slow pushed response may be canceled with CANCEL or REFUSED_STREAM on the promised stream.

requirement: A client does not send an END_STREAM frame on a server-pushed stream.

requirement: CONNECT uses :method CONNECT and host:port :authority while omitting :scheme and :path.

requirement: CONNECT requests must omit :scheme and :path.

notes: RequestData has no explicit CONNECT authority parameter independent from path; first define the adapter mapping rather than impose an accidental API convention.

requirement: After successful CONNECT only DATA and stream-management frames may be sent on the tunnel stream; other frame types are stream errors.
notes: The server scenarios are origin application handlers without a proxy tunnel; successful-CONNECT tunnel lifecycle is not represented in the frozen driver.

requirement: A supporting proxy establishes the target TCP connection before sending a successful 2xx response.
notes: Real proxy operations and external TCP tunnels are outside the baseline. No positive CONNECT parsing claim is made; acceptance and authority observation remain an explicit gap.

requirement: Tunnel DATA preserves TCP octets and END_STREAM corresponds to FIN, including an empty final DATA frame.
notes: Requires a duplex tunnel abstraction and half-close observations that RequestData/ResponseData do not expose.

requirement: TCP errors map to CONNECT_ERROR and HTTP/2 stream/connection errors reset the proxy TCP connection.
notes: Proxy TCP reset mapping is outside the selected fixture and cannot be inferred from an origin EchoBody response.

notes: Resource policy thresholds and performance/DoS stress are outside this bounded functional wire matrix.

requirement: SETTINGS_MAX_HEADER_LIST_SIZE is advisory; senders may exceed it and receivers may reject oversized messages.
notes: No test yet advertises a small limit and accepts the documented receiver alternatives without inventing a universal hard threshold.
